tool_args.rationale: The maximum pilot gradient, 2.44, exceeds the 2.36 gray-zone gate. The targeted high-gradient probe can identify or rule out the supercritical avalanche before fitting.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot enters the uncertified supercritical gray zone, where a threshold avalanche can mimic the smooth law below threshold.
The unresolved ambiguity is the high-gradient threshold, not temporal resolution.
The pilot is monotone and the verified guidance identifies a competing gradient-dependent threshold.
